# Membrane RTP H264 Plugin v0.20.6 - Table of Contents

> Membrane RTP payloader and depayloader for H264

## Pages

- [Membrane RTP H264 plugin](https://membrane-rtp-h264-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-rtp-h264-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.RTP.H264.Depayloader](https://membrane-rtp-h264-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.H264.Depayloader.md): Depayloads H264 RTP payloads into H264 NAL Units.
- [Membrane.RTP.H264.FU](https://membrane-rtp-h264-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.H264.FU.md): Module responsible for parsing H264 Fragmentation Unit.

- [Membrane.RTP.H264.FU.Header](https://membrane-rtp-h264-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.H264.FU.Header.md): Defines a structure representing Fragmentation Unit (FU) header
which is defined in [RFC6184](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6184#page-31)
- [Membrane.RTP.H264.NAL.Header](https://membrane-rtp-h264-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.H264.NAL.Header.md): Defines a structure representing Network Abstraction Layer Unit Header
- [Membrane.RTP.H264.Payloader](https://membrane-rtp-h264-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.H264.Payloader.md): Payloads H264 NAL Units into H264 RTP payloads.
- [Membrane.RTP.H264.StapA](https://membrane-rtp-h264-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.H264.StapA.md): Module responsible for parsing Single Time Agregation Packets type A.
- [Membrane.RTP.H264.Utils](https://membrane-rtp-h264-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.H264.Utils.md): Utility functions for RTP packets containing H264 encoded frames.
